PhotoCraft app icon (photocraft.svg, photocraft-small.svg and every file derived from them in
this directory: photocraft-1024.png, photocraft.icns, photocraft.ico, hicolor/).

Original artwork made for this project by the project owner: an engraving-style drawing created
in ArtCraft, then vectorised. No third-party material. Licensed like the rest of PhotoCraft,
under either of

  * Apache License, Version 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)
  * MIT license (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

at your option.

Regenerate the derived files with packaging/icons.sh.
